name: hero-ritchie-golden
js: (() => { const b = document.getElementById('btn-toggle-hud'); if (b && b.style.visibility !== 'hidden') { b.click(); b.style.visibility = 'hidden'; } document.querySelectorAll('.location-prompt, [class*=locate], [class*=geoloc]').forEach((e) => { e.style.visibility = 'hidden'; }); })()
